_comment: Live train map (proof of concept). Positions come from TD berth steps: SMART ties a berth to a station (CRS via CORPUS, coordinates via config/map-stations.json); berths between stations are interpolated along the berth graph, which is seeded from SMART and then learned from the live feed. See src/berth-geo.js.

region.name: Sussex
region._comment_bbox: [south, west, north, east] in degrees. A train is listed only if its resolved position is inside this box. TD areas are NOT listed here: every area with a SMART row at a station inside the box is subscribed automatically, so the area set follows the data rather than a hand-kept list. Set `areas` to override.

_comment_maxAgeSecs: A berth keeps its description until the train steps out or the signaller cancels it, so a train standing in a platform is still shown. This bounds descriptions that are never cleared (stabled units, signaller housekeeping) — they drop off after this long without a step.
_comment_staleSecs: After this long without a step the client draws the train faded: it is probably standing, not lost.
_comment_interpolation: A berth with no station of its own is placed between the nearest station-anchored berths behind and ahead of it, by hop count, searching at most maxHops each way. Edges seen fewer than minEdgeCount times are ignored when searching, so one mis-stepped description can't bend the line.
